# Tldv

Meeting recorder and transcription tool for video conferences

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/tldv/.

## Actions

- **Download Meeting Recording** (read-only): Download a meeting recording file.
- **Get Meeting** (read-only): Retrieve a meeting by its unique identifier.
- **Get Meeting Highlights** (read-only): Retrieve meeting notes (highlights) by meeting ID in human-readable format.
- **Get Meeting Transcript** (read-only): Retrieve the complete transcript of a meeting by its ID.
- **List Meetings** (read-only): Retrieve a paginated list of meetings from tldv.
- **Check API Health** (read-only): Verify API availability and health status.
- **Import Meeting**: Import a meeting, recording, or other media from a publicly accessible URL.
